facts.fact: Omnisend's analysis of 1.24 billion email popup displays in 2025 found an average popup conversion rate of 2.1%.
facts.quote: In 2025, analysis of 1.24 billion email popup displays found an average conversion rate of 2.1%

facts.fact: According to Omnisend, gamified Wheel of Fortune popups reached a 3.5% conversion rate.
facts.quote: gamified formats such as Wheel of Fortune popups reached 3.5%, a 41% relative lift over standard popups

facts.fact: Wisepops reported 2026 data showing that targeting new visitors with a welcome offer produced an 8.30% conversion rate.
facts.quote: targeting new visitors with a welcome offer produced an 8.30% conversion rate, compared with 5.09% for returning visitors

facts.fact: According to Strikingly, A/B testing can improve pop-up click-through rates by a minimum of 5% when headlines and offer types are systematically varied.
facts.quote: A/B testing can improve click-through rates by a minimum of 5% when you systematically vary headlines and offer types

facts.fact: Per the article citing Conversion Sciences, standard exit-intent pop-ups convert at an average of 3% to 5%.
facts.quote: Standard exit-intent popups convert at an average of 3% to 5%, and they can rise to over 10% for email list growth when the offer is a value-aligned content upgrade

facts.fact: Per the article citing Conversion Sciences, exit-intent pop-ups can rise to over 10% for email list growth when the offer is a value-aligned content upgrade tied to the page the visitor is leaving.
facts.quote: they can rise to over 10% for email list growth when the offer is a value-aligned content upgrade tied to the page the visitor is leaving
